cal.footer: your CalDAV calendar · the login sealed in your account · reminders while a page is open
cal.noCalendars: This login has no calendar for events. Make one on the server, then come back.
cal.gone: This event is no longer in the calendar.
cal.seriesNote: This event repeats: a change applies to every repeat.
cal.reminderHint: A reminder shows on a device while a page of the calendar is open there; your calendar’s other apps (Nextcloud, a phone’s calendar) show it too.
cal.title: Title
cal.error.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start.
cal.error.auth: The server did not take that username and password. Nextcloud wants an app password (Settings → Security → Devices & sessions).
cal.error.reach: The server did not answer this page. Is the address right, and does the server allow this hub (CORS)?
cal.error.notFound: No calendars at that address. For Nextcloud it is the server’s address, e.g. https://cloud.example.org.
cal.error.changed: The event was changed elsewhere meanwhile. It has been loaded again: try once more.
cal.error.readOnly: This calendar cannot be changed from here.
cal.connectText: The calendar shows your calendars from Nextcloud or any other CalDAV server. Name the server and sign in once.
cal.serverOffered: This hub passes calendar requests on to its own Nextcloud: keep this address.
cal.serverSuggested: The calendar server this hub suggests.
cal.serverHint: Your Nextcloud’s address (https://cloud.example.org) or any CalDAV address. A server elsewhere must allow this hub.
cal.passwordKept: kept: leave empty to keep it
cal.passwordHint: For Nextcloud, make an app password under Settings → Security → Devices & sessions, rather than giving your own password.
cal.keptInAccount: Your login is kept in your account, encrypted with your key, so the calendar is on every device you sign in on.
cal.keptOnDevice: Your login is kept with this device’s key, encrypted. With an account, the calendar follows you to every device.
cal.disconnectText: The login is removed from your settings on every device. The calendar itself stays on the server.
cal.calendarsText: The calendars shown here. Hidden ones stay on the server.
cal.remindersText: While a page of the calendar is open, its reminders show on this device; with notifications allowed, also when the page is in the background.
cal.notifyOn: Notifications are allowed on this device.
cal.notifyDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser’s settings.
cal.notifyUnsupported: This browser shows no notifications: reminders appear on the page.
cal.how.1: Your calendar stays on your server. Events you make here are on the server at once, and so in Nextcloud and on every phone that syncs with it.
